body.text: Virginia quietly ended its own AR-15 ban fight: the Attorney General's office told plaintiffs in writing it will not appeal the statewide injunction.

A July 20 filing in Crump v. Katz reproduces an email from Virginia's Deputy AG for civil litigation stating the Commonwealth "will not be appealing the Washington County injunction during the pendency of any stay." Paired with Wednesday's stay order, AR-15s stay on Virginia shelves until 60 days after SCOTUS decides Viramontes.
